notes: VAT 18% (URA: 18% on all supplies by taxable persons; jewellery in the manufactured tangible products scope). The only precious-metal exemption in the VAT Act is supplies to the Bank of Uganda for the State Treasury (Second Schedule 1(m)), so retail bullion is standard-rated. EAC CET HS 7108/7113 line rate not readable - duty null. No dealer bar list found.

sources.name: Uganda Revenue Authority - Manufacturing of Tangible products
sources.quote: VAT is a consumption tax charged at a rate of 18% on all supplies made by taxable persons i.e. persons registered or required to register for VAT purposes.
sources.what: Read 2026-11-28 (page updated 2025-10-01): VAT 18% on all supplies by taxable persons; scope of manufactured tangible products includes jewelry products.

sources.name: Uganda VAT Act, Cap. 349 (businesslicences.go.ug, Government of Uganda portal)
sources.quote: (m) the supply of precious metals and other valuables to the Bank of Uganda for the State Treasury;
sources.what: Read 2026-11-28: Second Schedule para 1(m) exempts only supplies of precious metals to the Bank of Uganda for the State Treasury; exports are zero-rated (Third Schedule).
